# Royal Kitchen website

Four-page static website adapted from the supplied template. Serve the project's dist directory with any static HTTP server. In the downloadable ZIP, open index.html at the root. No build or installation is required. Japanese and English views, company telephone links, restaurant listings, delivery services, LINE and address-based Google Maps are included.

The supplied photograph labels determine asset assignments. The hero is used as a cuisine illustration; interior and exterior photographs show the premises. No menu prices were inferred from photographs. Monthly revenue and submission metadata are excluded. The original incomplete map embed was replaced by an address-based map.

Original culinary artwork uses yellow, orange, copper and beige, with separate desktop and mobile compositions. Quality cards are white. The company name in the company table uses normal weight, and the location heading is one level smaller. Reservation and delivery cards use a diagonal white shine with a 0.55-second sweep and retain their service colors on hover. Original-artwork licensing is in assets/ORIGINAL-ARTWORK.txt within the download.

The website includes a redesigned language control and photo framing, a soft owner-message panel, matching company labels, the company telephone only, three reservation providers, and a two-photo indoor gallery advancing every four seconds. Gallery pauses on hover/focus and can be paused manually; reduced-motion preferences start it paused and disable the shine animation. The standalone map link was removed while the embedded map was modestly enlarged.
